lines.quote: Designed phased-array beamforming algorithms for a ground-based surveillance radar system: implemented a 24-channel adaptive digital beamformer with sidelobe control on an FPGA-based signal processor.

Embedded DSP in C/C++: developed the real-time beamforming kernel in C for a TI C6748 DSP running in the surveillance radar’s digital signal processor; maintained and extended the embedded codebase across multiple product iterations over fifteen years.
Production Python: author and maintainer of Kajanti’s internal antenna-pattern analysis package (~6 000 lines, used daily by RF and systems engineering teams, version-controlled and CI-tested).

Ran the full RF measurement campaign for a new K-band receiver module: S21/S11 measurements on the low-noise amplifier chain, noise-figure mapping across temperatures from −40 °C to +60 °C, and spurious response characterisation using an R&S ZNB40 vector network analyser.
